slides.kicker: It started before you understood it
slides.title: 15% of teens saw p*rn [[at 10 or younger.]]
slides.sub: If that was you — this explains a lot.

slides.title: At [[10 or younger]]
slides.body: In Common Sense Media's 2023 survey of U.S. teens, 15% had seen p*rn at 10 or younger — and 54% by 13.

slides.title: Wired [[early]]
slides.body: A University of Glasgow review linked earlier first exposure to p*rn with more frequent use and a higher risk of compulsive use later. A link — not destiny.

slides.title: It's [[not]] an excuse
slides.body: How it started explains it. It doesn't excuse staying stuck. You can't change age 10. You can change tonight.
